description: Fetch a page now and compare it with the previous snapshot of the same URL, returning whether it changed and a unified diff (no LLM). When to use: monitoring a page for updates - prices, docs, policy pages, SEO titles/meta; first call stores the baseline, later calls return added/removed lines. Do not use: for one-off reading (web_fetch) or structured fields (web_extract_schema). Returns: {ok, url, baseline, changed, diff, added_lines, removed_lines, previous_ts, current_ts, title, hash, chars, fetched_cached, took_ms, _metering}. fresh=true (default) adds a cache-busting query to bypass the 6h page cache; pass fresh=false to compare cached content. Snapshots are kept per URL in SQLite (latest only). Metered: shares the web free bucket (100 calls/day per IP), then 1 credit per call over x402.

fresh.description: Bypass the page cache with a cache-busting query. Default true.

max_chars.description: Compare at most this many chars (500-12000). Default 4000.

name: web_diff
title: Web Diff
